description: End-to-end workflow to design, order, provision, monitor, and manage a LPWAN (LoRaWAN/NB-IoT) connectivity service for IoT devices

tenant_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer account or tenant

project_id.description: Identifier for a logical project or deployment within a tenant

network_plan_id.description: Identifier for a designed LPWAN coverage and capacity plan

service_order_id.description: Identifier of a service order for LPWAN connectivity

device_profile_id.description: Identifier for a device profile including radio and payload configuration

subscription_id.description: Identifier for a connectivity subscription or SIM/eSIM bundle

gateway_id.description: Identifier for a LPWAN gateway/base station

device_id.description: Identifier for an IoT end device (e.g., DevEUI/IMEI)

deployment_id.description: Identifier linking a set of gateways, devices, and subscriptions in an active deployment

policy_id.description: Identifier for a traffic, QoS, or fair-usage policy

fault_ticket_id.description: Identifier for a fault or incident ticket created during monitoring

functions.name: design_network_plan
functions.description: Design an LPWAN network plan including coverage, capacity, and technology selection

geographies.description: Target service geographies for coverage planning

coordinates.description: List of lat/lng pairs for polygon or bbox

device_density.description: Expected device density and traffic profiles

per_km2.description: Optional device density per square kilometer

spectrum_constraints.description: Regulatory or license constraints on spectrum use

availability_target.description: Target service availability in percentage, e.g., 99.9

functions.returns: Proposed network_plan_id with recommended gateway count, technologies, and estimated costs

functions.name: validate_coverage_and_capacity
functions.description: Validate that a designed network plan meets coverage, capacity, and regulatory constraints

what_if_scenarios.description: Optional scenarios to test modifications of the base plan

functions.returns: Validation report with pass/fail for coverage, capacity, RF compliance, and scenario results

functions.name: create_lpwan_service_order
functions.description: Create a service order to fulfill an LPWAN connectivity deployment based on a network plan

order_items.description: Line items for gateways, subscriptions, and value-added services

functions.returns: Created service_order_id with initial status, pricing summary, and next steps

functions.name: get_service_order_status
functions.description: Retrieve current status and detailed breakdown for an LPWAN service order
functions.returns: Order status, milestones, related deployment_id (if created), and optional extra details

functions.name: register_device_profile
functions.description: Create a reusable device profile with radio, join, and payload settings

fixed_dr.description: Optional fixed data rate index for non-ADR

reference.description: Identifier for builtin decoder, JS function, or webhook URL

functions.returns: Created device_profile_id with full configuration details

functions.name: provision_deployment_resources
functions.description: Provision gateways, core network resources, and logical deployment for a service order

resource_overrides.description: Optional override of gateway placement or counts

functions.returns: deployment_id with list of allocated gateway_ids, core network instances, and initial status

functions.name: bulk_register_devices_and_subscriptions
functions.description: Register a batch of devices and associate them with subscriptions and a deployment
functions.returns: Batch operation status with per-device device_id and subscription_id mappings, and any validation errors

functions.name: configure_policies_and_qos
functions.description: Create or attach traffic, QoS, and fair-usage policies to a deployment or subset of devices

policy_id.description: Existing policy_id to attach, or omitted to create inline

functions.returns: List of applied policy_ids and scope mappings, with any conflicts or overrides described

functions.name: activate_lpwan_service
functions.description: Activate the LPWAN service for a deployment, including subscriptions and network routing

partial_activation.description: Optionally restrict activation to a subset of resources

functions.returns: Activation workflow status with any failed checks, and final service state once completed

functions.name: monitor_service_health
functions.description: Retrieve aggregated health, alarms, and KPIs for an LPWAN deployment
functions.returns: Aggregated health indicators, KPI time series, and list of active alarms or fault_ticket_ids

functions.name: handle_fault_and_recovery
functions.description: Open, update, and optionally trigger automated recovery for detected faults in the LPWAN service

fault_ticket_id.description: Required for update, close, retry_action, and rollback_change

context.description: Context for opening a new fault ticket

parameters.description: Action-specific parameters such as gateway_id or device_id

functions.returns: Fault ticket state, any executed recovery actions, and recommendations for further remediation

functions.name: modify_or_cancel_lpwan_service
functions.description: Modify key aspects of an active LPWAN deployment or initiate partial/full cancellation

modifications.description: Used when action is modify or cancel_partial

add_devices.description: New devices to add, same structure as in bulk_register_devices_and_subscriptions.devices

dry_run.description: If true, show impact without executing

functions.returns: Summary of modifications or cancellation, financial impact, and new deployment/service_order states

functions.name: bulk_import_service_orders
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple service_orders from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined service_orders, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_service_orders
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of service_orders matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped service_orders with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_service_orders
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of service_orders with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_service_orders
functions.description: Export a filtered set of service_orders to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_service_orders_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across service_orders with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with service_orders hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_service_order_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on service_order lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_service_order_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing service_order subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_service_order_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a service_order subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_service_order_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single service_order with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across service_orders for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_service_order_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of service_orders.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_service_order_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to service_orders with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of service_order jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_service_order_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight service_order job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_service_order_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a service_order (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_service_order_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive service_order change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_service_order_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a service_order approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_service_order_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a service_order, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_service_order_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a service_order, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_service_order
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a service_order for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_service_order_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a service_order from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_service_order_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over service_orders (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched service_orders.

functions.name: build_service_order_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over service_orders data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_service_order_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern service_order behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_service_order_policies
functions.description: List policies governing service_orders with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_service_order_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a service_order and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.

functions.name: get_service_order_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the full dependency graph for a service_order, with configurable depth and filtering.
functions.returns: Graph object with nodes (service_orders and related artefacts) and typed edges.
